question: What was the literacy rate of India as per census 1951?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.1833**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **literacy rate of India** as per the **Census of 1951** was **18.33% (0.1833 in decimal form)**.
 
• This marked the first-ever census conducted in independent India, providing a baseline for literacy and other demographic data.
 
• Out of the total population, the **male literacy rate was 27.16%**, while the **female literacy rate was significantly lower at 8.86%**.
 
• The overall literacy rate was calculated by considering individuals aged 7 years and above who could read and write with understanding in any language.
 
• The low literacy rate highlighted the need for large-scale educational reforms and policy interventions in post-independence India.
